title: 用 Gemini 先把 TikTok 参考视频逐镜头拆解成可用的 Seedance…
content:
用 Gemini 先把 TikTok 参考视频逐镜头拆解成可用的 Seedance 提示词（包含镜头角度/构图、光线、道具摆放、字幕样式、动作与节奏、音频设定）。

在 Seedance 2.5 复刻时按“Scene 1…Scene N”的结构写提示词，每个镜头标注时间段（如 00:00–00:01）并描述该镜头的具体画面与动作，便于像素级还原剪辑节奏。

想做批量带货复刻时，保留原视频的镜头语言与节奏不变，只替换提示词里的产品、模特/手部特征与声音/配乐设定，实现快速批量生成多条。

复刻快节奏开箱类视频时，在提示词里明确“~1 秒跳剪、按音乐鼓点同步”的节奏要求，并指定无口播+复古 soul/R&B 背景音乐的音频约束。

要稳定复刻该类开箱模板，在提示词中固定关键视觉锚点：俯拍顶视（top-down）、白色网格床单背景、柔和漫射自然光、产品盒与 logo 位置、手部服饰/戒指等一致性细节。

en.content:
Use Gemini first to break down the TikTok reference video shot by shot into usable Seedance prompts (including camera angle/composition, lighting, prop placement, caption style, motion and pacing, and audio settings).

When recreating in Seedance 2.5, write the prompt in a “Scene 1…Scene N” structure. Label each shot with a time range (e.g. 00:00–00:01) and describe the specific visuals and actions in that shot, so the editing rhythm can be reproduced pixel-perfectly.

If you want to mass-produce e-commerce recreations, keep the original video’s cinematography and pacing unchanged, and only replace the product, model/hand characteristics, and sound/BGM settings in the prompt to quickly generate multiple versions.

When recreating fast-paced unboxing videos, explicitly state pacing requirements in the prompt such as “~1-second jump cuts, synchronized to the music beat,” and specify audio constraints like no voiceover + retro soul/R&B background music.

To stably recreate this kind of unboxing template, fix the key visual anchors in the prompt: top-down overhead view, white grid-pattern bedsheet background, soft diffused natural light, the position of the product box and logo, and consistency details such as hand clothing/rings.

The prompt for this video

Scene 1 (00:00 - 00:01)
Visual Setup: Top-down vertical shot (16:9 POV) resting over a white textured grid-pattern duvet/bedsheet. Soft, bright, diffused natural sunlight fills the frame.

Product Placement: An open dark grey/charcoal New Balance shoe box with a white "NB new balance" logo centered on the lid. Inside, white tissue paper conceals the shoes.

Clothing: Cream/off-white chunky knit sweater sleeve visible on the bottom-left corner with subtle gold ring accents on fingers.

Captions: "unbox my new shoes with me 🍒☁️👟" displayed in lowercase white sans-serif font centered on the tissue paper.

Audio/Mannerisms: No spoken voice; upbeat retro-pop soul music playing. A hand enters from the left to grasp the top tissue layer.

Scene 2 (00:01 - 00:02)

Visual Setup: Dynamic close-up, top-down angle with high motion.

Product Placement: Tissue paper is swiftly flipped to the left, revealing grey suede and mesh New Balance 992 sneakers nestled inside the charcoal box.

Clothing: Cream knit sleeve, light manicured nails with a thin gold ring.

Captions: None.

Audio/Mannerisms: Fast, energetic peeling motion pulling paper back.

Scene 3 (00:02 - 00:03)

Visual Setup: Top-down shot over the box.

Product Placement: Paper is pulled back completely to the left, fully exposing one shoe inside the New Balance box.

Clothing: Hand holding tissue paper at the upper-left edge.

Captions: None.

Audio/Mannerisms: Tissue held wide to showcase the shoe nestled in the box.

Scene 4 (00:03 - 00:04)

Visual Setup: Close-up top-down shot on the bedsheet.

Product Placement: Left hand lifts both grey New Balance sneakers by their heels/collars, holding them suspended right above the white grid sheet.

Clothing: Cream knit sweater sleeve, light nails, gold ring.

Captions: None.

Audio/Mannerisms: Quick, smooth holding gesture showcasing both shoes together.

Scene 5 (00:04 - 00:05)

Visual Setup: Flat-lay top-down shot.

Product Placement: Shoes placed on the bedsheet angled slightly toward the upper-left. Hand taps/adjusts the left heel.

Clothing: Hand wearing cream knit sweater sleeve entering from bottom-left.

Captions: None.

Audio/Mannerisms: Light, aesthetic finger tap setting the shoe into place.

Scene 6 (00:05 - 00:06)

Visual Setup: Straight-on top-down flat-lay shot.

Product Placement: Shoes laid horizontally, one facing right, one facing left to feature side-profile silver "N" logos, premium grey suede, and layered midsoles. Hand adjusts bottom heel.

Clothing: Hand with cream knit sleeve touching the bottom shoe.

Captions: None.

Audio/Mannerisms: Subtle micro-adjustment for visual alignment.

Scene 7 (00:06 - 00:07)

Visual Setup: Symmetrical top-down flat-lay shot.

Product Placement: Both sneakers positioned side-by-side facing straight up, centered on the white bedsheet.

Clothing: Out of frame.

Captions: None.

Audio/Mannerisms: Static clean hero shot.

Scene 8 (00:07 - 00:08)

Visual Setup: Symmetrical top-down view.

Product Placement: Both shoes pointing straight up, showcasing white laces, grey mesh toe boxes, and "new balance" embroidered tongue text.

Clothing: Out of frame.

Captions: None.

Audio/Mannerisms: Static presentation shot.

Scene 9 (00:08 - 00:09)

Visual Setup: Dynamic top-down angled shot.

Product Placement: Shoes placed diagonally across each other, highlighting side profiles and the 992 heel detailing.

Clothing: Out of frame.

Captions: None.

Audio/Mannerisms: Clean layout display.

Scene 10 (00:09 - 00:09)

Visual Setup: Final close-up flat-lay angle.

Product Placement: Final diagonal display shot focusing on the tonal grey suede overlay materials and dual-tone white/cream midsole before video loops.

Clothing: Out of frame.

Captions: None.

Audio/Mannerisms: Brief hold ending the video loop.

Audio & Pacing Overview

Voiceover: None.

Track Tone: Nostalgic, cheerful, mid-tempo soul/R&B track ("Oh My").

Pacing: Fast, rhythmic ~1-second jump cuts perfectly synced to the music beats.

Usa Gemini para desglosar primero el video de referencia de TikTok, plano por plano, en prompts utilizables para Seedance (incluyendo ángulo de cámara/composición, iluminación, colocación de props, estilo de subtítulos, acciones y ritmo, y configuración de audio).

Al recrear en Seedance 2.5, escribe los prompts con la estructura “Scene 1…Scene N”, marcando el tramo de tiempo de cada plano (por ejemplo, 00:00–00:01) y describiendo la imagen y la acción concretas de ese plano, para facilitar una reconstrucción a nivel de píxel del ritmo de edición.

Si quieres hacer recreaciones masivas para ventas, mantén sin cambios el lenguaje visual y el ritmo del video original, y solo sustituye en el prompt el producto, las características del modelo/mano y la configuración de voz/música, para generar rápidamente varias versiones.

Al recrear videos de unboxing de ritmo rápido, deja explícito en el prompt el requisito de ritmo “~1 segundo de jump cuts, sincronizados con el beat de la música”, y especifica restricciones de audio como “sin voz en off + música de fondo soul/R&B retro”.

Para recrear de forma estable este tipo de plantilla de unboxing, fija en el prompt los anclajes visuales clave: toma cenital/top-down, fondo de sábana blanca con patrón de rejilla, luz natural suave y difusa, posición de la caja del producto y del logo, y detalles consistentes de la mano/ropa/anillos, etc.

fr.content:
Utilisez Gemini pour décomposer d’abord, plan par plan, une vidéo de référence TikTok en prompts Seedance exploitables (incluant l’angle de caméra/la composition, l’éclairage, le placement des accessoires, le style des sous-titres, les mouvements et le rythme, ainsi que les réglages audio).

Lors de la recréation dans Seedance 2.5, rédigez les prompts selon la structure « Scene 1…Scene N », en indiquant pour chaque plan une plage temporelle (par ex. 00:00–00:01) et en décrivant précisément l’image et l’action de ce plan, afin de reproduire le rythme du montage au pixel près.

Pour des recréations en série orientées e-commerce, conservez inchangés le langage de caméra et le rythme de la vidéo d’origine, et remplacez uniquement dans les prompts le produit, les caractéristiques du modèle/des mains, ainsi que les réglages de voix/ musique, afin de générer rapidement plusieurs variantes.

Pour recréer des vidéos d’unboxing au rythme soutenu, précisez dans le prompt une exigence de rythme du type « jump cuts d’environ 1 seconde, synchronisés sur les temps de la musique », et définissez des contraintes audio telles que l’absence de voix off + une musique de fond soul/R&B rétro.

Pour reproduire de manière stable ce type de template d’unboxing, fixez dans le prompt les repères visuels clés : vue plongeante (top-down), fond de drap blanc à motif quadrillé, lumière naturelle douce et diffuse, position de la boîte produit et du logo, ainsi que les détails de cohérence comme les vêtements/les bagues des mains.

ja.content:
Gemini を使って、まず TikTok の参考動画をショットごとに分解し、Seedance 用の実用的な prompt に落とし込む（カメラアングル/構図、光、小道具の配置、字幕スタイル、動きとテンポ、音声設定を含む）。

Seedance 2.5 で再現する際は、「Scene 1…Scene N」の構成で prompt を書き、各ショットに時間帯（例：00:00–00:01）を付けて、そのショットの具体的な画面と動きを記述すると、ピクセルレベルで編集テンポを再現しやすい。

大量の物販系リメイクをしたい場合は、元動画のショット言語とテンポはそのまま維持し、prompt 内の product、model/hand の特徴、そして sound/BGM 設定だけを差し替えることで、複数本を素早く量産できる。

テンポの速い開封系動画を再現する場合は、prompt 内で「~1 秒の jump cut、音楽のビートに同期」といったリズム要件を明確にし、さらに voiceover なし + retro soul/R&B の BGM という音声制約を指定する。

この種の開封テンプレートを安定して再現するには、prompt の中で重要な visual anchor を固定することが大切：俯瞰の top-down、白い grid 柄の bedsheet 背景、柔らかく拡散した自然光、商品箱と logo の位置、手元の服/指輪などの一貫したディテール。

ko.content:
Gemini로 먼저 TikTok 참고 영상을 샷별로 분해해 바로 쓸 수 있는 Seedance 프롬프트로 정리합니다(샷 앵글/구도, 조명, 소품 배치, 자막 스타일, 동작과 리듬, 오디오 설정 포함).

Seedance 2.5로 복제할 때는 “Scene 1…Scene N” 구조로 프롬프트를 작성하고, 각 샷마다 시간 구간(예: 00:00–00:01)을 표시한 뒤 해당 샷의 구체적인 화면과 동작을 묘사하면, 픽셀 단위로 편집 리듬을 재현하기 쉽습니다.

대량 상품 판매용 복제를 할 때는 원본 영상의 샷 언어와 리듬은 그대로 유지하고, 프롬프트 안의 제품, 모델/손의 특징, 사운드/배경음악 설정만 바꿔 빠르게 여러 편을 생성합니다.

빠른 템포의 언박싱 영상 복제 시에는 프롬프트에 “~1초 점프 컷, 음악 비트에 맞춰 동기화”라는 리듬 요구를 명확히 적고, 무보이스 + 레트로 soul/R&B 배경음악이라는 오디오 제약도 지정합니다.

이런 언박싱 템플릿을 안정적으로 복제하려면 프롬프트에서 핵심 시각 앵커를 고정해야 합니다: 탑다운(top-down) 정면俯拍, 흰색 그리드 패턴 침대 시트 배경, 부드럽고 확산된 자연광, 제품 박스와 로고 위치, 손의 의상/반지 등 일관성 있는 디테일.

pt.content:
Use o Gemini para primeiro decompor o vídeo de referência do TikTok, cena por cena, em prompts utilizáveis para o Seedance (incluindo ângulo de câmera/composição, iluminação, posicionamento de props, estilo de legendas, ações e ritmo, e configuração de áudio).

No Seedance 2.5, ao recriar, escreva os prompts na estrutura “Scene 1…Scene N”, marcando o intervalo de tempo de cada cena (por exemplo, 00:00–00:01) e descrevendo com precisão o visual e os movimentos de cada tomada, para facilitar uma reconstrução quadro a quadro do ritmo da edição.

Se a ideia for fazer recriações em massa para vendas, mantenha inalteradas a linguagem de câmera e o ritmo do vídeo original, trocando apenas nos prompts o produto, as características do modelo/mãos e as configurações de voz/música, para gerar rapidamente várias versões.

Ao recriar vídeos de unboxing em ritmo acelerado, deixe explícito no prompt o requisito de ritmo “~1 segundo de jump cut, sincronizado com a batida da música” e especifique restrições de áudio como sem narração + música de fundo soul/R&B retrô.

Para recriar com estabilidade esse tipo de template de unboxing, fixe no prompt os principais pontos de referência visuais: top-down (vista de cima), fundo de lençol branco com padrão quadriculado, luz natural suave e difusa, posição da caixa do produto e do logo, e detalhes consistentes como roupa/anel nas mãos.
